Combining like terms, we get:

\[

Rearranging all terms to one side, we get:

\[
3ks - 4tks - 7ts + 8t - 7ts + 10 - 5s + 6 = 0

\[
(3k - 4 - 7)ts + (8 - 7)ts + (3k - 4 - 5) = 0

\[

\[
k = \frac{11}{3}
